CAIP neither changes original media nor publishes anything automatically.

Release requires source-deliverable approval, factual visible copy, selected public-allowed media, descriptive lead-image text, stable paths, and SEO fields. Publishing and unpublishing are deliberate, source media stays untouched, and optional metrics remain manual and explainable.

The release preserves original media, generates factual drafts only, and requires review before queueing or publishing.
